title.en: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SIX, RELATING TO RECOGNIZANCES, STIPULATIONS, BONDS, AND UNDERTAKINGS, AND TO ALLOW CERTAIN CORPORATIONS TO BE ACCEPTED AS SURETY THEREON.

text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Five hundred and thirty-six, entitled "An Act relative in
recognizances, stipulations, bonds, and undertakings, and to allow certain corporations to be accepted as
surety thereon," is hereby amended by striking out the words "five hundred thousand dollars" in the second
sentence thereof after the words "less than" and inserting in lieu thereof the words "two hundred and fifty
thousand dollars. "

Section eleven of said Act Numbered Five hundred and thirty-six is hereby amended so as to read
" Section 11. This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and three. "

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 28, 1902.
